title: Chat→VTC guide: activeCallId and join banner
description: Section on the call-active banner. Server setting activeCallId on Chat when bound VTCCall enters active. Client rendering: 'A call is active — Join' banner in channel header. Clicking join: VTCParticipant/set create. Clearing banner on call end. StateChange subscription for Chat to detect activeCallId changes. JSON examples of Chat/get response with activeCallId, VTCParticipant/set create to join.
